Ivy (docs): Quick flag: API ref for PATCH /v1/projects/{project_id}/settings lists `visibility` enum as ["public", "private"] but runtime accepts `team` as a third option. Example snippet uses `private` only and the JS SDK example maps the field to `isPublic` boolean.

Rahul (eng): Surprise, we added `team` last quarter for org-scoped projects and forgot to update docs. Also response example shows 200 with `settings` object but actual response returns 204 No Content.

Marta (sdk): Oof. JS SDK wrapper currently accepts `visibility` string but the docs-to-boolean mapping is wrong. I'll update the SDK examples and add a deprecation note for the old `isPublic` helper in next minor.

Owen (pm): Customer impact = medium (confusing deploys for org teams). Let's get a small docs PR that: 1) adds `team` to enum, 2) replaces boolean example with explicit `visibility` string, 3) note that endpoint returns 204. Also coordinate SDK PRs.

Ivy (docs): Draft changes: OpenAPI enum update + example request using `visibility":"team"` and a curl showing `204` response with no body. I'll also add migration blurb in the settings page explaining `team` is for org-scoped projects. Opening PR and requesting Rahul/Marta review.

docs-bot: PR opened by Ivy (docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4501 (labels: docs,bug)

Rahul (eng): I'll add a quick integration test asserting patch returns 204 and accepts `team`.

Marta (sdk): Will open js-sdk#712 and py-sdk#249 to update snippets and remove boolean helper later. Linking SDK PRs from the docs page once they're ready.

Ivy (docs): Action items: [x] update enum and examples in OpenAPI, [ ] add migration blurb to release notes, [ ] link SDK PRs. Closing when SDK PRs are linked and tests pass.

Rahul (eng): Tests passed; merging controller-side docs-compatible test.

docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4501 (merged by Rahul)

Marta (sdk): SDK PRs opened and linked from docs. Notifying support. Thread resolved.
